## Description
Provide a concise summary of the changes introduced in this pull request and the rationale behind them.

Closes #(issue_number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding platform capability)
- [ ] Curriculum content (new lesson, course module, or knowledge check)
- [ ] Mission / challenge addition or validator improvement
- [ ] Playground example addition or enhancement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance or security hardening

## Content / Code Integrity Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code standards and architecture principles of BPFQuest.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run content:validate` and all content checks pass without errors.
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and resolved any ESLint warnings.
- [ ] I have executed `npm test` and all automated test suites pass.
- [ ] I have verified the production build with `npm run build`.
- [ ] If adding a mission, I added a validator case in `missionValidator.js` and updated unit tests.
- [ ] I have verified keyboard accessibility and responsiveness for any new UI components.
- [ ] No fake metrics, artificial counts, or simulated statistics were added.
